## Problem

What is wrong or missing today, and why it matters to someone using Radar.

## Scope

What this issue covers. Keep it to one change.

## Starting points

- `path/to/file.go`
- `path/to/Component.tsx`

## Out of scope

Follow-up work that belongs in a separate issue.

---

### Before you start

**Check the linked pull requests on this issue first.** GitHub lists them in the
timeline below and in the sidebar. If someone already has an open PR here, please
don't start a second one — comment on theirs instead, or ask us for another issue.

To claim this, comment and we'll assign you. If nothing is linked within a week
we'll unassign so someone else can pick it up — no hard feelings, just say the
word if you want it back.

Small fixes are fine to send without claiming. Check the linked PRs either way.
